title: Replace tabix leaves (tbx_name2id, tbx_destroy, tbx_seqnames, tbx_readrec) with pure Rust
description: Replace 4 tabix FFI leaf functions: tbx_name2id (4 lines, hash lookup), tbx_destroy (13 lines, cleanup), tbx_seqnames (28 lines, extract names from hash), tbx_readrec (21 lines, tab-separated record parsing). All are leaves. Used in src/tbx/mod.rs. Complexity: easy-medium.
